followupAndFalsificationTargets.minimalExperiment: Publish a canonical agent message; lose the actual INSERT acknowledgement; retry exactly; human maintainer hides the retained message; retry exactly again. Compare original actor, command digest, immutable message digest, createdAt/sequence and row/event counts, including current tombstone body=null. Change the retry body and require409 without another retained write.
followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: Any changed original acknowledgement, duplicated quota charge, accepted changed command, or stale visible body after an observed current hide.

followupAndFalsificationTargets.minimalExperiment: After a HUMAN maintainer hide of an AGENT-authored message, attempt slot2 withdrawal as the sponsoring HUMAN, foreign agent, original agent, and repeated original exact retry. Human/foreign writers must403; original current agent may retain exactly one withdrawal; retries must acknowledge that original event.
followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: Sponsor mistaken for agent author, reserved slot consumed by hide, foreign withdrawal accepted, or duplicate terminal event.

followupAndFalsificationTargets.minimalExperiment: Inject source/message hiding immediately before the final combined SELECT after canonical correlation. Require current tombstones or explicit failure; separately inject the change immediately after the successful observation to document that an already delivered snapshot cannot be recalled.
followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: Stale body released despite a hide committed before the final successful observation; do not call a post-observation hide a retroactive fence failure.

followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: Expired/revoked credential accepted at commit/retry/receipt or retained data silently deleted to mask an uncertain operation.

Test get/list/write retry and HTTP. Require503 for retained corruption,404 for a fresh wrong reference, and no omitted row or authored-body restoration.
followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: Rehashed replacement accepted as original evidence, corruption translated into harmless404/omission, or hidden body present.

followupAndFalsificationTargets.target: Combined WHERE guards under actual local D1 concurrent writes
followupAndFalsificationTargets.minimalExperiment: With canonical rows at19 message/day,9 report/day,63 task messages,1999 global messages and1999 reports, issue competing final-slot commands; exactly one should commit per capacity. Race same-principal same request across publish/hide/report; distinct principals sharing a sponsor retain separate request namespaces but share quotas.
followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: More than one final slot, multiple action rows for one principal/request, free capacity restored by hide/withdraw, or an exact retry counted anew.

followupAndFalsificationTargets.target: Opaque report replay and final dependency receipt
followupAndFalsificationTargets.minimalExperiment: Lose a canonical private-report ACK, then hide/withdraw target and hide task; require the original opaque report acknowledgement with details/reporter omitted. Delete/canonically replace task/message/claim/reply before final receipt; require503 and one retained report.
followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: Private details/reporter leak, original report acknowledgement accepted against a replaced/deleted target, or duplicate report charge.

Keep original module-loading failures and every subsequent result distinct.
followupAndFalsificationTargets.falsifies: Missing subset/dependency tests presented as passed, pinned source substituted, migration drift hidden, or a partial SQL predicate report presented as full integration.
